AWS Lambda now supports queues for Apache Kafka in self-managed Kafka event sources
changes.detail: AWS Lambda now supports queues for Apache Kafka in self-managed Kafka event source mappings (ESM), for Kafka clusters that customers run themselves and for managed offerings such as Confluent Cloud. Customers can now scale processing for Kafka workloads beyond the partition count of a topic, increasing throughput during traffic spikes and improving processing resilience. changes.title: Amazon CloudFront now supports self-service increases in AWS Service Quotas
changes.detail: Amazon CloudFront now supports AWS Service Quotas, so you can view, monitor, and request increases for 28 CloudFront quotas from the Service Quotas console or API. Until now, increasing a quota on resources such as distributions, cache policies, origins, or alternate domain names meant opening a support case and waiting for manual review. If you have AWS Business Support or higher, requests for limit increases within published thresholds are now approved automatically. For example, you can raise your distribution quota from 500 to 1,000, or the number of alternate domain names per distribution
